evidence.quote: Table 13 row 55 (USD in thousands): Total investments | $ | 1,735,720 | 1,694,770 | 166.2

Table 6 rows 4-7 (USD in thousands): non-controlled, non-affiliated investments 1,675,484; non-controlled, affiliated investments 8,469; controlled, affiliated investments 10,817; Total investments, at fair value 1,694,770.
Holdings for report_date 2026-03-31 sum to 1,675,484,000 non-affiliated plus 19,286,000 affiliated, or 1,694,770,000 total.

rationale: The filing provides an explicit final Total investments row, so total_row is the appropriate method. The row includes non-controlled non-affiliated, non-controlled affiliated, and controlled affiliated investments. Its fair value is 1,694,770,000, exactly matching companyfacts. The companyfacts tag therefore captured the full investment total, not only the non-affiliated subtotal. The result is 96.05% of total assets of 1,764,592,000, leaving a plausible non-investment remainder of 69,822,000.
